source_title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold gets a $250 Amazon price drop
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Amazon just knocked $250 off the Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold, dropping it from its $1,899 recommended retail price to $1,649. That’s a 13% discount relative to the RRP, and it’s the lowest price we’ve seen since launch, so this is a good time to grab Google’s premium foldable for less.
The Pixel 11 Pro Fold is Google’s most advanced foldable yet, built around the Tensor G6 chip with 16GB of RAM and a big focus on Gemini-powered features. It has a large book-style inner display for apps, videos, and multitasking, plus a more phone-like outer screen that’s easier to use when the device is closed. That design makes it feel more practical day to day while still giving you the bigger screen when you open it up.
Cameras are one of the stronger reasons to look at this phone. The Pixel 11 Pro Fold packs a versatile triple-camera setup that generally beats many rival foldables in image quality. Performance is also described as smooth in everyday use, which is what most people will care about most.
Battery life is said to be acceptable to good, and the full package is described as a polished update that makes a lot of sense for anyone who wants Google’s software, AI tools, and strong camera results in a foldable. It also has a 4.5-star Amazon rating, which adds a bit more confidence to the deal.
At $1,649 on Amazon, this is the kind of premium phone discount that stands out.
